items.headline: Pereira throws 3 TDs, Owens has pick-6 as Georgia State tops App State for first time in 13 tries
items.description: - Ayden Pereira threw three touchdown passes, Coby Owens turned in a pick-6 and Georgia State defeated Appalachian State 39-23 on Saturday.

items.headline: Bryant's 4 FGs, Todd's rushing TD help Georgia Southern beat Appalachian State 19-3
items.description: — Taeo Todd had a rushing touchdown, Tripp Bryant kicked four field goals, and Georgia Southern beat Appalachian State 19-3 on Saturday night.
